title: Clean CPVP 16x
description: Clean CPvP 16x is a minimal Crystal PvP texture pack with clean 16x textures, reduced clutter, and improved visibility for smooth, competitive PvP gameplay.
body: Clean CPvP 16x is a lightweight Crystal PvP-focused resource pack designed for maximum clarity and smooth gameplay. It removes visual clutter to help you focus during fights, featuring shortened swords, low fire, minimal particles, and simplified textures for items like totems, crystals, and gapples. The pack keeps a clean 16x resolution for better FPS and performance while improving visibility in fast-paced PvP situations. Overall, it’s made for competitive players who want a clear screen, fast reactions, and a smoother PvP experience without distracting visuals.
